verdict.rationale: A platform-wide OpenAPI spec is confirmed live at developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json, and an llms.txt index exists, giving AI-native users machine-readable access to Cloudflare's API surface. However, there's no evidence of a Sandbox SDK-specific OpenAPI/spec (the SDK is a code-level Workers binding, not a REST API), and per-page markdown docs return 404.
